{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=November 2021}}
{{Use list-defined references|date=November 2021}}
'''Elena Georgievna Glagoleva''' ({{langx|ru|Елена Георгиевна Глаголева}}, 8 April 1926 – 20 July 2015){{r|mathedu|obit}} was a Soviet and Russian mathematician and mathematics educator who organized a correspondence school for the mathematics in the Soviet Union based at [[Moscow State University]],{{r|mathedu|5years}} and as part of the project coauthored two mathematics textbooks with [[Israel Gelfand]].{{r|mathedu}}

She is the author of:
*''Метод координат'' (with I. M. Gelfand and [[Alexandre Kirillov|A. A. Kirillov]], 1964); translated into English by Richard A. Silverman as ''The Coordinate Method'' (Pocket Mathematical Library, Gordon & Breach, 1969),{{r|silverman}} and by Leslie Cohn and David Sookne as ''The Method of Coordinates'' (Library of School Mathematics, MIT Press, 1967; Dover, 2002){{r|moc}}
*''Функции и графики'' (with I. M. Gelfand and E. E. Schnol, 1965); translated into English as ''Functions and Graphs'' by Richard A. Silverman (Pocket Mathematical Library, Gordon & Breach, 1969){{r|silverman}} and by Thomas Walsh and Randell Magee (MIT Press, 1969; Birkhäuser, 1990; Dover, 2002);{{r|fg}} translated into German by Reinhard Hoffmann as ''Funktionen und ihre graphische Darstellung'' (Teubner, 1971){{r|hoffmann}}
*''Электричество в живых организмах'' (''Electricity in Living Organisms'', with M. B. Berkinblit, 1988)
